LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands! About the Role At Workwize, we're helping IT teams to easily equip their remote and global teams with all necessary IT equipment. Our automated SaaS platform simplifies hardware deployment, management, and retrieval with fast, reliable deliveries in 100+ countries. With 50.000 users and 120.000 devices under management, we're solving hybrid work challenges like laptop deliveries, returns and equipment tracking, allowing IT teams to focus less on manual hassles and more on strategic initiatives. Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize, your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide. LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands! Raise the bar. Don't wait to be asked. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer. Not a senior title for someone who executes well, but the engineer other engineers calibrate against. You see the thing that's broken, decide it's worth fixing, and start. Nobody assigns that to you. We want to be blunt about the bar, because last time we weren't. This role is not "ship tickets faster than a mid-level engineer". It's technical leadership, coaching, challenging how we work, and being the person the EM and PM think out loud with. If that's not the job you want, this will be a bad year for both of us. About Workwize Workwize is the platform IT teams use to equip and manage remote and global workforces. We deliver, track, and retrieve hardware in over 100 countries, with 50,000 users and 120,000 devices under management today. We're one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands, a LinkedIn Top 10 Startup (2025) and ranked #6 by Deloitte in the 50 fastest-growing Dutch tech companies. We work from a flat, open environment out of our Amsterdam HQ and across 40+ nationalities worldwide. What you'll do - Lead feature work end to end: shape the scope with the PM, make the architectural calls, decide what to cut, and own whether it actually worked once it's live. - Use agents and AI tooling as your default way of building, and pull the rest of the team up to where you are. What you can do with a model this month should be what the team can do with it next month. - Coach the engineers around you, including the ones who are not junior. Pairing, review, handing over scope, and direct feedback that changes how someone works. - Change how we work without asking permission first. Spot the process that's costing the team time, build the case, get the buy in, and show the before and after. - Be a real partner to the EM and PM. Push back on the roadmap, bring the problem nobody had noticed, and say the uncomfortable thing early rather than politely late. - Connect what you ship to what the company is trying to achieve, with a number you chose and then went back and looked at. Who you are - You have 8+ years building software at product companies, and you're currently a Senior Software Engineer, Lead Engineer, Tech Lead, Senior Full Stack Engineer, Senior Product Engineer or similar. You've worked in a real cross functional team, not alone and not in a two person shop. - You have a deep technical and architecture foundation. You can explain how the systems you built fit together, why you made each trade off, and what would break first under load. AI makes you faster, it does not stand in for understanding what you shipped. - You use AI and agents as your default way of working, and you can name the tools, models and harnesses. You know exactly which parts you still do yourself and why, and you read what the agent produced closely wherever it touches data, money or auth. - You've coached peers, not only juniors, and you can point to a specific skill someone has now because of you. - You've driven a change in how a team works and confirmed with a metric that it landed. - You're an extremely strong communicator. You get to the point, you can hold a constructive disagreement without it getting personal, and feedback is something you go looking for rather than something you survive. - You have judgment about what not to build. The fastest way to ship is to cut the right thing, and you'll defend that call. - You're proactive to the point of being slightly annoying about it. You'd rather fix it and tell people afterwards than raise it and wait. Nice to have - Experience at a fast growing SaaS or B2B product company. - Running evals, watching inference cost, or dealing with model failure modes like hallucination in production. - Experience being the technical counterpart for a PM or EM on a roadmap, not just on a sprint. What this role is not - Not a role where improvements wait for a one on one. If you need to be asked, this isn't it. - Not a role where seniority means scope of tickets. It means scope of influence. - Not a role where you can be excellent alone. If the team isn't better a quarter after you join, we both got it wrong. Workwize Offers - Flexible hybrid work environment. - Top-notch tools and equipment provided. - Vibrant, entrepreneurial culture with opportunities for growth. - Off-sites and multi-yearly team bonding events. - Team lunches and surprise events to keep things fun. - Pension scheme. - Classpass corporate membership. Our Team Becoming part of Workwize means making an impact. We make sure that we will contribute to the change in the way of working. For us it is also important that we make an impact on our employees, that they feel challenged and ease. We consist of a rapid growing and ambitious team with all different backgrounds. Entrepreneurs, Operational specialists, Developers, Sales gurus you can find them all at Workwize and are always on the look-out for the next original ideas to reach more consumers and create the best value for our customers. We are looking forward to meeting you and discover if there is a match with the Workwize team!

data.description:
About Us Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution. We are seeking Senior Software Engineers to contribute to our core geometric modeling technologies that support design, presentation, and analysis of homes. We are remote-first, this role can sit anywhere in the continental US or Canada. What You'll Do Expect to: - Conceive and implement algorithmic solutions to the most difficult geometric modeling problems - Work closely with other engineers, product, and customer success teams to define expected behavior, discover gaps in existing product, and ultimately ensure customers are happy - Write tests to verify that your code can handle the worst corner cases. - Mentor junior developers to write code as robust as yours. About You The right candidate for this role prioritizes working software over perfection and wants to deliver code, get user feedback, and iterate. Your ability to be hands-on, while also focusing on the bigger strategic picture, sets us apart. You're not hesitant to deeply understand our codebase to contribute effectively to it. You have: - 5+ years of experience working in CAD or geometric modeling - Knowledge of geometric modeling concepts techniques such as but not limited to meshes, BReps, NURBS, and BSPs. - Able to understand and navigate a large TypeScript + React codebase - Professional fluency with modern development tools, including AI-assisted workflows, paired with clear ownership of the correctness, maintainability, and behavior of the code you produce. - Excellent communication within a dynamic organization — highlighting tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and making decisions considering various alternatives - Ideally you have a strong interest in the homebuilding industry, whether it's a passion for homes, construction, or home design and you’re motivated by the prospect of elevating an entire industry through geometric modeling. While we've identified the core experience and skills required above, please still apply if you have more or different experience than this! We will use your previous experience and performance across the series of interviews to establish appropriate level within our organization in a fair and equitable way. Working at Higharc Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process. Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D. Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

The position will directly support and lead the expansion of our hydraulic engineering capabilities in the dams and levees market, leveraging existing staff resources, and collaborating with other senior dam and levee practitioners across the firm. Projects span hydraulic modeling of various complexities; hydraulic structure evaluation and design (e.g. spillways); supporting probabilistic risk analysis; hydraulic and hydrologic modeling for large riverine systems; flood modeling; and dam breach consequence assessment studies. Geosyntec is an innovative, international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Our engineers, scientists, technical and project employees serve our clients from offices across the world. Ranked by ENR as one of the top environmental engineering design firms, Geosyntec is internationally known for its technical leadership, broad experience, and exceptional client service. We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Geosyntec will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits and well-being programs to support you and your family. To Learn More Visit: Essential Duties and Responsibilities - Provide technical leadership and guidance to expand the hydraulic engineering practice within Geosyntec’s Dams and Levees business line. - Work on rehabilitation and design of existing and new spillways, outlet works, and other appurtenant dam and levee hydraulic structures. - Downstream hazard assessment and dam breach modeling for inundation mapping and support of direct and indirect economic consequence estimation. - Inspections of existing hydraulic structures and dam safety review of previous analyses and studies against the current state of the practice and design criteria. - Flood hazard studies, reservoir routing and stage-discharge frequency analyses in support of semi-quantitative and fully quantitative risk assessments; - Interacting with client representatives; - Task and project-level responsibility for scoping, performing, managing, and delivering multiple concurrent project assignments; - Consistent with our sell-manage-do business model, play a role in lead generation, business development, staff development, and mentoring; - Help broaden our reputation and visibility via publishing and presenting at prominent industry conferences such as US Society on Dams, Association of State Dam Safety. - Task and project management, including planning and directing staff, budgeting and budget management, adherence to schedule, quality, client satisfaction, and profitability; - Recruiting, supervising, and mentoring junior staff; and - Preparing technical reports, letters, memoranda, plans, specifications, presentations, and proposals. Education and Licensure - Bachelor's degree in science field, preferably biological sciences, engineering or related field. (required) - Advanced degree (e.g., M.S. or Ph.D.) in epidemiology or related field. (preferred) Skills, Experience and Qualifications - At least 5 years (7+ preferred) of related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience. (required) - Experience with multi-disciplinary project teams. (required) - Experience with project management and business development. (preferred) - Excellent leadership and detail oriented. (required) - Experience performing hydrologic studies for dams and specific experience performing probabilistic flood hazard analyses. (preferred) - Experience with modeling tools such as platforms like HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS (1-D and 2-D), or similar (required). CFD or other 3-D models (preferred). HEC-LifeSim, HEC-FIA, DAMRAE or similar. (preferred) - Team player who enjoys networking, exceptional oral and written communication skills. (required) - Ability and willingness to perform fieldwork and travel for site visits, inspections, and other business-related meetings or conferences. (required) - Regular field work and overnight travel. (required) - Current OSHA 40-hr HAZWOPER training and refreshers. Job Summary Senior Interoperability Architect, Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) Job Summary: Aptive seeks a Senior Interoperability Architect to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. You will develop, refine, and maintain the interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, and profiles, that define how Veteran health information moves between VistA/CPRS, the Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR), the Department of Defense, and community providers. The role supports the Interoperability specialty area, including the Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE), FHIR standards innovation, standards-based interfaces, and national exchange frameworks. You will work within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Trains alongside interoperability specialists, terminologists, and VA Business Owners. Primary Responsibilities - Interoperability Specifications. Develop, refine, and maintain interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, profiles, and implementation guides, for VA exchange use cases. - Standards Analysis. Analyze industry standards, VHA business requirements, and relevant technological innovation to recommend specification approaches. - HL7 and FHIR Design. Design solutions using HL7 V2, C-CDA, and FHIR, including FHIR profiles and API specifications that extend VA’s use of standards-based APIs. - Community Care and Partner Exchange. Define specifications that support exchange with community care providers, the Department of Defense, and other partners, aligned to national exchange frameworks. - Device and System Interfaces. Develop standards-based specifications for device and system interfaces that support the Federal EHR. - Discovery Projects. Lead discovery and prototyping for new standards needs, such as consent management and time zone interoperability. - Conformance and Adoption. Define conformance criteria and testing approaches, and track adoption of standards across VA systems and exchange partners. - Federal Policy Alignment. Align specifications with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework, USCDI, and applicable federal interoperability policy. - Architecture Runway Collaboration. Contribute interoperability architecture inputs to OCI’s Architecture Runway Collaborative and to cross-team dependency reviews. - Agile Team Participation. Participate in Planning Interval (PI) Planning, backlog refinement, iteration ceremonies, and system demos; help decompose Epics into Features with clear acceptance criteria. - Technical Guidance and Briefings. Provide technical guidance to analysts and informaticists, and present architecture recommendations to OCI leadership and VA Business Owners. Minimum Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree required. - Minimum of 10 years of experience in standards development, adoption, and conformance. - Experience developing, refining, or maintaining interoperability specifications, such as standards, data models, profiles, or implementation guides. - Familiarity with HL7 specifications, including V2, C-CDA, and FHIR. - Familiarity with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework and related federal interoperability policies. - Experience analyzing industry standards and business requirements to design interoperability solutions. - Ability to obtain and maintain a VA background investigation at the level assigned to the position; must reside and work in the United States with U.S. work authorization. Desired Qualifications - Master’s degree in health informatics, computer science, or a related field. - HL7 FHIR Proficiency or another HL7 certification. - Experience authoring FHIR implementation guides, participating in HL7 workgroups, or sponsoring ballots. - Experience with national exchange frameworks, such as eHealth Exchange, Carequality, CommonWell, or TEFCA. - Experience with FHIR conformance testing tools, such as Inferno, Touchstone, or the HL7 FHIR Validator. - Experience with VA systems, such as VistA/CPRS, VHIE, JLV, or VA Lighthouse APIs, or with the Federal EHR (Oracle Health). - Experience on SAFe or Scrum teams. Introduction Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact! Overview AIT, a global company with 170+ locations worldwide, is building the team that will build our next-generation technology. As part of this, we're opening a new development center in Tel Aviv. The Founding Software Engineer, Skunkworks is an individual-contributor engineer on AIT's new Skunkworks team, responsible for building key elements of what a company of this size will run on. As a founding engineer on the new team, this role helps select the architecture, stack, and tooling, and establishes the engineering practices that will shape the next chapter of how the company develops software. This is a hands-on role that designs, builds, and ships production systems solving real operational problems. The engineer works AI-natively, using agents, RAG, and LLM pipelines, and applies AI-assisted development as a daily force multiplier. They thrive in ambiguity - because the map isn't drawn yet. The role ships to production and owns systems end-to-end in production, ensuring reliability, quality, auditability, and operational performance, and demos work directly to company leadership. In addition to having a significant impact on the company's evolution in the software space, we offer a compensation package that is market-competitive in Israeli tech. Join us, and you'll quickly see your work in the hands of the people who move freight. Responsibilities - Platform Architecture & Build - Build AIT's next-generation technology from the ground up, contributing to the selection of architecture, stack, and tooling. - Partner with operations stakeholders to translate appropriate operational pain points into shipped software. - Make and document the foundational technical decisions expected of a founding engineer on the Skunkworks team. - AI-Native Development - Design, build, and operate capabilities using agents, RAG, and LLM pipelines. - Apply AI-assisted development as a daily force multiplier across the engineering workflow. - Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, and tooling and adopt what measurably improves delivery. - Production Ownership - Ship to production and own systems end-to-end in production. - Ensure the reliability, quality, and operational performance of the systems this role builds. - Engineering Culture & Practices - Establish the engineering practices, standards, and quality bar across the work this role builds. - Demo work directly to company leadership as appropriate. About AIT Worldwide AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the Chicago-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, energy, food, government, high-tech, industrial, life sciences and marine. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. Responsibilities Peraton is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to support the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Volcano Hazards Program (VHP). In this role, you will serve as an embedded technical contributor within the VHP government team, designing, developing, documenting, and deploying a modern, cloud-ready database and associated data visualization tools that support the program’s monitoring and evaluation (M&E) workflows. Your work will directly enable scientists, program managers, and stakeholders across the five U.S. volcano observatories and the Volcano Disaster Assistance Program (VDAP) to track performance, visualize geospatial hazard data, and produce evidence-based reports. Work Location: Remote Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities: - Database Design & Development — Analyze government-furnished M&E plans and existing VDAP M&E database code; design and implement a relational database (PostgreSQL/PostGIS) supporting VHP monitoring and evaluation data; develop stored procedures, views, data validation logic, and comprehensive data dictionaries; architect the database for mobile device accessibility. - API & Backend Development — Design and implement RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI or Flask) to expose database functionality; develop data ingestion tools and ETL workflows to load M&E data from existing sources; implement metadata management aligned with USGS standards; conduct unit and integration testing of all backend components. - Front-End & Visualization Development — Develop a web-based and mobile-friendly data entry and reporting interface using JavaScript/TypeScript and React; create an easily editable content management tool allowing VHP staff to update the M&E framework without developer intervention; build interactive dashboards and visualization modules for M&E analysis and reporting with filtering, drill-down, and export capabilities. - GIS & Geospatial Visualization — Develop GIS-enabled tools for spatial visualization of volcano data tied to M&E evaluation criteria; implement interactive web mapping using ESRI JavaScript API, Leaflet, or Mapbox; integrate geospatial layers with the database backend via RESTful APIs; leverage ArcGIS, ArcPy, GDAL/OGR, and PostGIS spatial functions. - Cloud Readiness & Architecture — Architect all systems to be cloud-ready, portable, and maintainable, aligned with USGS approved architecture and security baselines; document deployment configurations for future migration to CHS-supported cloud and hybrid environments. - Documentation — Produce and maintain all required documentation including user guides, data dictionaries, API references, system schemas, and deployment guides; follow USGS coding and documentation standards throughout. - Security & Compliance — Complete required DOI security awareness training; adhere to FISMA, NIST, and DOI security requirements; support Certification and Accreditation (C&A) activities; confirm all web-based applications include USGS-approved logon banners; report any computer security incidents per DOI procedures. - Section 508 Accessibility — Validate all web-based interfaces against WCAG 2.0 Level A and Level AA success criteria; apply universal design principles including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and screen reader compatibility; remediate any non-conforming features. - Collaboration & Communication — Attend and actively participate in weekly check-in meetings with VHP staff and the volcano-hazards software development team; provide written progress updates (work completed, planned, issues, risks); integrate feedback from the VHP Coordinator and COR; coordinate with teams across the five U.S. volcano observatories to maintain system interoperability. - Travel — Travel to Natural Hazards Mission Area offices for up to three (3) on-site visits during the 12-month period of performance (3–5 business days each) for onboarding, system integration meetings, or collaborative working sessions. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: - Bachelors degree and 8 years professional experience, or a Masters degree and 6 years professional experience, or an Associates degree and 10 years professional experience; Are you passionate about the Linux kernel? Want to enable and secure the foundation of Akamai Cloud Platform? Join our Cloud Platform Infrastructure Group - Linux Infrastructure team Our team is part of Cloud Platform Infrastructure Group, developing distributed systems that support Akamai's large global network. At the core of Akamai infrastructure, we work on complex and exciting systems that are available 24/7. Critical to Akamai, our Linux Infrastructure team develops, maintains, and ensures reliability, security, and performance of a custom Linux distribution with Akamai-specific extensions and settings. Build the future through innovation and automation You will be an integral part of a multi-faceted globally-distributed development team that builds, maintains, and improves Akamai's custom Linux kernel. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for: - Developing new features to improve performance, reliability, and security of Akamai Cloud Platform - Porting existing Akamai modifications to newer versions of Linux kernel - Debugging and fixing issues found in a variety of complex test and production environments - Enhancing existing build and test automation to facilitate Continuous Testing - Collaborating closely with platform and application developer and test teams as well as Akamai hardware development teams - Working with the open source community to upstream your work - Staying current with upstream Linux kernel and OS changes and emerging industry trends Do what you love To be successful in this role you will: - Have 5 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree or its equivalent - Have 3+ years of experience in software development in C with a focus on Linux kernel development and also scripting (Perl/Python/Shell) - Have a solid understanding of Linux kernel internals and experience with Linux kernel debugging - Be familiar with at least two of the following subsystems required: memory management, filesystems, block IO, TCP/IP stack, KVM) - Have a good working knowledge of concurrent programming, data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, and network protocols (TCP/UDP/IP, Ethernet, QUIC, HTTP/TLS) - Be a motivated self-starter who enjoys collaborating with others but capable of working independently - Possess excellent verbal and written communication skills About us At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day. Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone. Our focus is simple: Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance. Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data. Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch. AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform. At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works. Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits. FlexBase adapts to your job's needs Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work. We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both. Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like! Compensation Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $121,400 - $218,600/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
data.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer Blurb.fm · Remote (Canada) · Full-Time ## The Company Who We Are Blurb builds revenue-generating content products for the most influential media companies in the world. We scale content from what already exists — turning catalogs and brand assets into high performing formats for every major platform. Our mission is simple: help media companies unlock growth through high volume, high impact content. ## The Team How We Work We are a nimble, execution obsessed team of engineers who thrive on solving real business problems with smart, scalable solutions. Engineering at Blurb is about building the backbone that powers performant content systems for our clients, not writing speculative code. We are a small, high trust team. There is no handoff culture here. Every engineer scopes, architects, builds and ships. You will work closely with designers, product, and creative leads and you will own your work end to end. We care about impact, not just implementation. We engineer with speed, stability and long term adaptability in mind. ## The Role What You Will Do As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a core contributor to the platform that makes content at scale possible. You will architect, build and maintain systems that handle high volume video and content workflows for major media clients. This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role. You will not be managing or delegating, you will be doing. Priority is execution. In your first 30–60 days - Work closely with the team to deeply understand our products, APIs, and infrastructure. - Get comfortable in the codebases by shipping bug fixes and small features. - Begin identifying areas of improvement in architecture, developer experience, or tooling. Once you are fully ramped - Architect new products and features with stability, flexibility and performance in mind. - Own large scale efforts from technical scoping through to production delivery. - Lead the development of new tools and production pipelines. - Maintain and evolve infrastructure proactively, not just reactively. - Ensure quality of all deliverables. Set the bar, then hold it. - Contribute ideas that improve how we build and what we build. This role is NOT right for you if - Your best work is coordinating and delegating rather than writing code. - You prefer a structured corporate environment with established processes and a full team around you. - You expect someone else to resolve ambiguity before you can move. - You rely on AI to produce code you do not fully understand or cannot defend. This is a builder role. You will write code every single day. ﻿ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Hard Skills - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful back-end or full-stack ownership. - Strong, production-grade TypeScript (Node.js) — this is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have. - Solid Python skills, especially for data-heavy or ML-adjacent work. - Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Services (Firebase/Firestore, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Compute Engine). - Proven ability to own the full product lifecycle: architecture build delivery maintenance. - Experience designing and scaling systems for high-volume, performance-sensitive workloads. - Comfort working in a Linux environment; Bash/shell scripting is a regular part of the job. How You Work - You thrive in ambiguity. You define requirements when they are unclear instead of waiting for them to be handed to you. - You are a self directed executor. You pick up tasks, figure them out and ship without needing to be unblocked at every step. - You are comfortable using AI as a productivity multiplier (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) while maintaining your own critical thinking, you architect and analyze code yourself, you do not outsource it. - You communicate clearly and proactively across any medium, async messages, docs, code reviews or live calls. - You are an advocate for documentation and organized codebases, but pragmatic about what actually gets read and used. - You are adaptable. Priorities shift in a startup, you shift with them without losing momentum. - You have genuine curiosity about the work: side projects, new tools, emerging patterns in your domain. Bonus points - Experience with video processing, media pipelines, or content-at-scale infrastructure. - Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow for ML adjacent tasks. - Experience with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, or modern React patterns. - Prior startup experience — especially as a hands on IC in a small team. - Passion for the music or media industry. ## The Stack Technologies You Will Work With - TypeScript (Node.js) - Python - Google Cloud Services - Firebase / Firestore - Cloud Functions / Cloud Run - Compute Engine - Next.js - Tailwind CSS - PyTorch / TensorFlow - Linux - Bash / Shell Scripting - Adobe After Effects ## Life at Blurb What to Expect - Fully remote. We are a distributed team and have been from the start. We have an office in Calgary where you can use. - High ownership, low bureaucracy. You will have real influence over how we build and what we build. - A small, senior team. No layers, your work ships directly to production and to clients. - Fast moving environment. We iterate quickly and expect the same from the people we hire. We move quickly when we find someone great. If this sounds like the right environment for you, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/senior-full-stack-developer-blurb-inc

data.title: IT & Business Systems Manager
data.description:
The Opportunity: Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises, sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As an IT & Business Systems Manager, you'll independently own IT and Business Systems for DataGrail, including endpoints, applications, and day-to-day operations for our team — operating with significant autonomy and shaping how the function runs, Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you'll be the face of technology for DataGrail's employees, the first call when something breaks, and the person building the automated, self-service systems that let the company scale without scaling manual support. You'll partner closely with Security to build the controls DataGrail needs for ISO compliance, with real ownership over how this function evolves — and you'll extend the security engineering function's execution capacity, partnering hands-on across day-to-day security workstreams rather than simply implementing controls handed down from Security. This is a chance to take a function in transition and build it into something modern: moving IT from reactive support to an automated, self-service operation, partnering directly with Security on ISO compliance, and growing the scope of the role as DataGrail scales. What You'll Do: - Own IT and business systems operations for DataGrail's remote workforce, including endpoint management, identity, and the SaaS application footprint — provisioning and deprovisioning employee access across every tool, with an accurate inventory of renewals reviewed monthly. - Deliver hands-on technical support across the company, resolving issues at the desktop level and setting the standard for fast, first-call resolution. - Run onboarding and offboarding for the device and account lifecycle, delivering a smooth new-hire IT experience and a clean exit when people leave. - Partner with Security to build and maintain the access controls, endpoint policies, and audit trails required for ISO compliance. - Partner hands-on with DataGrail's security engineer, executing across day-to-day security workstreams such as tooling rollouts, and access reviews. - Build automation and self-service tooling that reduces manual ticket volume while preserving strong controls and visibility. - Administer DataGrail's Apple-based fleet end to end, from MDM policy to OS upgrades to hardware lifecycle. - Manage vendor relationships and DataGrail's SaaS vendor management process — onboarding and offboarding vendors and maintaining accurate records ensuring technology spend goes toward the right long-term solutions. - Partner proactively across functions — surfacing IT needs, aligning on priorities, and serving as a reliable, go-to point of contact for teams that depend on IT — building the systems and automation that make it easy for cross-functional partners to self-serve What You'll Bring - Proven, senior-level experience independently owning a distributed, remote-first IT environment at a company DataGrail's size — spanning endpoints, identity, and business applications, with full accountability for the function rather than execution against someone else's roadmap. - A track record of operating with high autonomy — setting direction for the function, making judgment calls independently, and being trusted with minimal day-to-day oversight. - Hands-on experience administering MDM platforms (e.g., Kandji, Jamf, Hexnode) and Apple hardware and OS in an enterprise setting. - Strong understanding of identity and access management tools like Okta, and how they intersect with security and compliance requirements. - Experience building or maturing security and compliance controls, such as endpoint compliance or access reviews, ideally in support of a framework like ISO 27001. - Comfort executing on security initiatives you didn't design, including vulnerability remediation, tooling rollouts, access reviews — working effectively in support of another owner's strategy. - A track record of automating manual IT workflows through scripting or self-service tooling to reduce ticket volume and improve consistency. - Scripting experience in Python, and working with Claude Code and other AI tooling for building automation and self-service tools and supporting Security functions as needed. . - Experience managing IT vendor relationships and technology spend against a formal vendor management process. - Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues for non-technical stakeholders. Bonus Points - ISO 27001 (or similar framework) certification, or direct experience supporting an ISO audit. - Prior IT experience in a regulated industry or another SaaS company handling sensitive data. What Success Looks Like Within 90 Days You'll: - Learn DataGrail's systems, tools, and team, and take ownership of IT helpdesk coverage so employees have reliable, first-call support again. Within 180 Days You'll: - Independently own endpoint and access management, with foundational ISO-relevant controls in place, early automation and self-service initiatives underway, and functioning as an active hands-on execution partner to the security engineer. Within 365 Days You'll: - Have positioned DataGrail for ISO audit readiness, with self-service systems in place that reduce manual ticket handling while strengthening the company's control and audit posture. Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state. All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $130,000—$175,000 USD About Us: DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Our identity security solutions secure and enable thousands of companies worldwide, giving our customers unmatched visibility into the entirety of their digital workforce, ensuring workers have the right access to do their job – no more, no less. Built on a foundation of AI and ML, our Identity Security Cloud Platform, Atlas delivers the right level of access to the right identities and resources at the right time—matching the scale, velocity, and changing needs of today’s cloud-oriented, modern enterprise. About the role: As a DevSecOps Engineer you will be a key player on the Infrastructure and Platform Services team servicing the Identity Security Cloud platform. You will proactively work with Engineering, Product, Services, and other functional departments to implement and operate our global customer-facing SaaS infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced job, thrives on problem solving, and is committed to delivering seamless product availability to large enterprises around the world. Responsibilities will include implementing file integrity monitoring, collecting and automating collection of audit evidence, implementing and hardening base images used throughout the company, and more. Must be willing to work at least 4 overlapping hours with US time zone. Must be willing to work in an on-call rotation. This is a fully remote opportunity. Our team works with multiple different teams to implement security improvements, implements tools and utilities for automating security, and provides subject matter expertise on securing our SaaS environment running in AWS. Begin working on projects and improvements we have planned By 90 days: - Collaborate on projects with team members and other teams - Be fully integrated with the team, join the on-call rotation to support our product - data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Internal Tooling
data.description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The role: We are looking for a Senior, proactive Software Engineer to join our Devops/Devex engineering team and help building and scaling the internal development platform. You would be building the tools, services and automations that empower the rest of our engineering team to ship safely and fast. RevenueCat invests heavily in tooling. We already have custom services for CI/CD, automated one-push-per-commit releases with automatic canaries, Feature Flags, DB query approval workflows, VPN access workflows. We are using Pulumi and python for IaC to describe k8s services and associated infrastructure in a single place. We want to provide autonomy, build a self-serve culture that allows teams to move fast but ensures safety and best practices. The advent of IA and agentic development is going to change a lot of things, and you will help shape this future fostering adoption while ensuring our security and architectural standards remain sane. Your job is to take all this to the next level. About you: - You are a Builder: You don't just use tools; you build them. data.description:
Overview Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai. Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees. Responsibilities Description Empower AI is seeking a Knowledge Center Team Lead to supervise a team of Tier I Knowledge Center (KC) agents supporting the external industry partners and users of a Department of War agency on its portfolio of mission applications (e.g., DISS, NISS, NBIS). External users reach the KC through a dedicated toll-free number, support email, public web form, and public chatbot, and the KC agent creates and manages the ticket on their behalf. The Team Lead owns real-time team performance against SLAs and XLAs, coaches agents on external-user handling and manual ticket creation, enforces the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and coordinates escalations to application resolver groups. The Team Lead also owns the handoff between the external-facing KC and the internal application resolver groups that support the mission. External users cannot see internal systems, so when a Tier I KC agent cannot resolve an issue, the Team Lead determines the correct resolver group, ensures the ticket is complete and correctly prioritized, tracks it to resolution, and manages communication back to the external user through the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process. This role analyzes escalation patterns to reduce future escalations and is the KC's senior technical resource for complex application issues. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers. THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED. JOB DUTIES: - Supervise a team of Tier I service desk and Knowledge Center analysts across core hours (6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET) and extended-hours shifts, including scheduling, coverage planning, attendance, performance management, coaching, and professional development. - Own real-time and daily operational performance: monitor contact volumes, queue health, ticket aging, First Contact Resolution, Tier 0 deflection, and PL1-PL4 SLA adherence, and take corrective action to keep open tickets exceeding resolution SLA within the acceptable quality level. - Enforce the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and ticket documentation standards through a structured quality assurance program, including ticket audits, call and chat reviews, and calibrated feedback. - Lead the service desk's response to PL1/PL2 critical incidents, including communications, situational awareness alerts, and coordination with Tier II, endpoint, communications, and application resolver groups. - Analyze escalated external-user tickets to determine the correct application resolver group, required information, and Priority Level, and manage seamless, documented handoffs while retaining ownership of the customer outcome. - Track escalated tickets against PL1-PL4 resolution SLAs, drive follow-up with resolver groups, and manage external-user communication and the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process. - Serve as the KC's senior technical resource for complex application issues (account, access, role, workflow, and data issues on DISS, NISS, NBIS, and other designated applications), resolving what can be resolved within KC authority. - Analyze escalation drivers by application, recommend knowledge articles, chatbot content, and process changes that reduce escalations, and contribute to Problem Resolution Action Plans and the CX Roadmap. - Serve as the senior technical decision-maker within Tier I, analyzing the most complex incidents and service requests to determine root cause and business impact, and deciding resolution strategy, priority, and escalation across Tier II, Tier III, and specialized resolver groups. - Own team-level queue management decisions: assess real-time contact volumes and ticket aging, rebalance work across analysts, and direct actions to protect PL1-PL4 SLAs, First Contact Resolution targets, and the acceptable quality level for aged tickets. - Design and administer the Tier I quality assurance review process, evaluating tickets and customer interactions against standards, enforcing the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and determining coaching and corrective actions for analysts. - Lead analysis of Tier 0/I trend and escalation data to identify recurring and high-impact problems, and prepare After-Action Reviews, Root Cause Analyses, and Problem Resolution Action Plans with recommended permanent solutions. Qualifications REQUIREMENTS: - Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 1 year of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted). 7 total years (education/experience) required. - Must be a U.S. Citizen. - Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start. - Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs. - Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting. - Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties. - Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision. - Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in enterprise IT service desk, help desk, or end-user support, including experience as a lead or senior analyst. - Expert troubleshooting skills across Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, network connectivity, VPN, printers, mobile devices, and common enterprise applications. - Extensive experience with an enterprise ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow), including reporting, knowledge management, and queue management. - Demonstrated experience improving First Contact Resolution, SLA adherence, and customer satisfaction through process, knowledge, and coaching initiatives. - Experience performing ticket quality reviews, mentoring analysts, and delivering training. - Ability to work assigned shifts within a 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET core schedule, and willingness to work extended-hours shifts if assigned to the extended-hours team. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief supervisors and Government stakeholders on performance and trends. DESIRED SKILLS: - HDI Support Center Team Lead, HDI Desktop Support Technician, or ITIL 4 Foundation / Practitioner certification. - Experience using ServiceNow (incident, request, knowledge, CMDB, Service Catalog, Virtual Agent) or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform. - Experience working across multiple security enclaves (NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS) and with classified system handling procedures. - Familiarity with customer experience (CX) measurement, including CSAT, Customer Effort Score (CES), and experience level agreements (XLAs). - Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or other compliance-driven Federal IT environments. - Experience with AI-enabled service desk capabilities (ServiceNow Virtual Agent, AI Ops, predictive analytics) and measuring Tier 0 deflection. - Experience contributing to Problem Management, Root Cause Analysis, and continuous improvement programs. About Empower AI All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. data.title: Platform Engineer
data.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day. We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us. - Taking ownership and driving impact - Being open to change and feedback - Being passionate about our mission and our customers. Your Mission At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity. As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security. What You'll Do You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale. - Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications. - Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices. - Boost developer productivity by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles. - Drive reliability and scalability through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions. - Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively. - Collaborate and innovate by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki. What You'll Bring You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others. - Cloud-native expertise: At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure. - Automation mindset: Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible. - Observability experience: Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance. - Strong ownership: You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience. - Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions. - Continuous learning: You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem. How We Work The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations. - We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience. - We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements. - We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities. Where You'll Be This is a Hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will work from our Lisbon Hub a minimum of 2 days per week. This role is open to candidates worldwide. For selected candidates, Catawiki can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support to the relevant location, subject to eligibility and applicable restrictions. In Return You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians. - A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience. - Meal Allowance Card stipend per working day, in addition to salary. - Health Insurance from day 1 (including dental coverage), with access to multiple hospitals and clinics and a vast wellness network. - A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills. - Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki. - Amazing Office right in the centre of Lisbon. Why You'll Love Working with Us - Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business. - Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression. - A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work. - Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location. Our Offices and Way of Working Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based. Interested? Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

As a member of the Platform Operations Infrastructure Team, you are a resilient learner and problem solver. You have a solid grasp of the engineering lifecycle and are comfortable working in an Agile environment. You are a proactive communicator who enjoys technical challenges and is eager to grow your skills within a world-class engineering organization. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: We are seeking a Software Engineer II, DBE to provide essential support to our database platform and infrastructure. If you're looking for an environment where you can learn from seasoned experts, work with cutting-edge cloud tech, and grow your career, then this is the path for you! We partner with engineering teams to establish standards, improve reliability, and increase cost-efficiency. Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired. This is a great opportunity to contribute to a team scaling cloud infrastructure to meet high demand and rapid growth. Our Database Engineering Team consists of people passionate about solving customer problems and who remain calm in the face of technical challenges. THE SKILL SET: - 5+ years of experience managing or supporting cloud-based database systems (AWS/GCP). - Core Database Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of RDBMS (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and experience with NoSQL systems (MongoDB or Cassandra). - Infrastructure as Code (Basic): Experience using or modifying automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible. - Scripting: Proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine administrative tasks. - Operational Fundamentals: Understanding of database backups, replication, and high-availability concepts. - SQL Proficiency: Solid SQL skills with the ability to troubleshoot and tune basic query performance issues. - Scaling Awareness (Plus): Exposure to distributed systems or horizontal scaling concepts (e.g., sharding or read-replicas) is a plus. - Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, with a collaborative mindset suited for a remote-first, distributed environment. An overview of this role As Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity, you'll own three functions that all require hands-on technical depth, not just people management. Platform Staff is a small, senior, AI-native team that moves to wherever the organization needs the most leverage, from standing up early scaffolding for an initiative, to taking on a high-impact customer request that doesn't fit any existing team's charter, to stepping directly into a production crisis until it's resolved. This role is for a technical engineering director who has personally built distributed systems, not only managed people who did. You'll use clear metrics, strong operating rhythms, and direct technical judgment so these teams deliver predictable outcomes without relying on one-person heroics. What you’ll do - Own outcomes for Git & Gitaly Operations, including hiring and developing the Manager, Git & Gitaly Operations, and holding the function to its reliability bar across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS. - Own outcomes for Nonlinear Productivity, also known as Friction Elimination, including hiring and developing the Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, and holding the function to measurable metric movement rather than activity. - Build and oversee Platform Staff directly as a small, senior team that uses AI-assisted tools as a standard part of its work. - Assess, case by case, what Platform Staff picks up, such as a new team that needs bootstrapping, a customer request too specific for any existing team's charter, or a crisis that needs someone in the room immediately. - Assess when Platform Staff should hand work off to a permanent team once it's stable. - Set the technical bar across all three functions by personally reviewing distributed systems designs, friction-elimination fixes, and crisis management plans with equal depth. - Build the operating rhythm and metrics that keep all three functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours. - Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis. What you’ll bring - Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform capabilities so you can assess productivity friction, operational trade-offs, and team needs in context. - Hands-on experience designing and shipping distributed systems personally, not only through teams you've managed. - A track record running highly effective engineering operations, including production reliability and incident management, at meaningful scale. - A track record driving measurable engineering productivity improvements across more than one team or organization. - Experience with AI-assisted development tools, and sound judgment about when they help a small team do work that would otherwise require a larger team. - People management experience across multiple managers or functions at once. - Ability to context-switch effectively across genuinely different problem types, including infrastructure operations, developer productivity, and ad hoc crisis response, sometimes in the same week. - A track record making staffing decisions that keep a high-leverage team intentionally small, and building alignment around those decisions rather than growing the team by default. About the team We work across three connected platform and productivity functions. Through Git & Gitaly Operations, we are responsible for the production reliability of the infrastructure layer underneath GitLab's own version control system. Through Nonlinear Productivity, we drive measurable improvements to GitLab's software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows. Through Platform Staff, we provide focused senior engineering capacity for high-leverage work that needs direct ownership before it can be stabilized or handed off to a permanent team. Collectively, we help GitLab improve the reliability, productivity, and responsiveness of the platform that powers how our customers and GitLab team members build software. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200 colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Information Systems Architect to define the best practice in infrastructure as code at a global scale. Join us to advance the state of the art, and shape the infrastructure behind tens of millions devices running Ubuntu. The Information Systems (IS) team is responsible for all IT operations at Canonical, including the infrastructure for building, packaging and distributing Ubuntu globally. As the IS architect, you will own the design of hardware and software implementation from PCI lanes to CDN and everything in between. Our goal is to be a reference operation, using the latest capabilities in Ubuntu and open source more generally, with the most modern operating principles. Your choices will impact the Ubuntu user experience for millions of users, and drive how Canonical’s engineers engage with compute and network resources in a devops setting. As the IS Architect, you’ll be in a unique position to improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on. You do this by leading System Reliability Engineers (SRE) and Data Center Engineers (DCE) to embrace best practices, and make informed decisions on technology choices in all aspects of cloud infrastructure and services. You will coach the IS team on automation, reliability, operational/technical scalability, network infrastructure and security. This is a home based position, with twice-annual travel to company events totaling around 4 weeks per year. Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region The role entails - Define, get buy-in and implement the holistic vision of a world class internal cloud - Setup, maintain and update the technical design roadmap and guidelines for the SREs within IS, with the aim of improving reliability, resilience, operational scalability, and technical scalability - Collaborate with, and provide the cloud-ops software development teams with input for roadmap, requirements and prioritization to build a world-class, highly standardized and automated operation - Provide the IS management with input and advice with regards to technology, reliability, resilience and business cases - Lead technical choices to implement solutions as self-service products, ensuring scalable operation - Collaborate with product security as well as operations security to set best practice and mitigate new threats in a timely manner - Automate operations for reuse across the world's largest companies, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems - Collaborate with development teams to design service architecture, documentation, playbooks, policies and operational procedures - Analyze incidents and events, and establish what the reason behind the reasons are, and what structural improvements can be made to minimize the chance of them reoccurring What we are looking for in you - Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university - Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path - Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation - Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results - Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts, technologies & operation - Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls, internet transit and large scale/bandwidth networking. - Experience dealing with significant production outages, incident response and postmortems - A passion for writing, sharing, and maintaining enterprise open-source software solutions - Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person - Be familiarized and passionate about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian Nice-to-have skills - Modern software engineering background (peer-review, unit testing, SCM, CI/CD, Agile) - Hands-on experience of automatic administration of enterprise Linux servers at scale What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. - Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year - Annual compensation review - Recognition rewards - Annual holiday leave - Maternity and paternity leave - Employee Assistance Program - Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues - Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote
